strategy.overview: Selectable song modes start at the left orbit, while each Multiball has its own shot-built qualification. Choose with the flippers, then double-tap a flipper or press Start to begin the selected mode. Hit targets 1, 2, and 3 for Dead City Radio, or complete the center drop three times and make three inner-orbit locks for House of 1,000 Corpses.
strategy.simpleOverview: Shoot the left orbit to open mode selection. Choose with the flippers, then double-tap a flipper or press Start to begin. For a quick Multiball, hit targets 1, 2, and 3 to start Dead City Radio.
strategy.summary: Start a selectable mode by shooting the left orbit, choosing with the flippers, and double-tapping or pressing Start. Dead City Radio starts as a three-ball Multiball after targets 1, 2, and 3; House of 1,000 Corpses requires three drop-target completions and three inner-orbit locks.

quickInfo.name: Selectable mode
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the left orbit, choose with the flippers, then double-tap or press Start.

quickInfo.name: Dead City Radio
quickInfo.summary: Hit numbered targets 1, 2, and 3 to start three-ball Multiball.

quickInfo.name: What?
quickInfo.summary: Collect chicken and gasoline above, then bash Spaulding three times.

quickInfo.name: House of 1,000 Corpses
quickInfo.summary: Drop the center target three times, then make three inner-orbit locks.

steps.text: Shoot the left orbit to open mode selection.
Move through the choices with the flippers, then double-tap a flipper or press the Start button to begin the selected mode.
For the shortest Multiball route, hit numbered targets 1, 2, and 3 to start Dead City Radio three-ball Multiball.
During Dead City Radio, shoot the ramp for Jackpots, then return to targets 1, 2, and 3 for its bonus collections.

alternatives.title: House of 1,000 Corpses route
alternatives.when: Use this when the center drop and inner orbit are safer than the three numbered targets.

steps.text: Knock the center drop target down three times.
Shoot the inner orbit three times to lock the balls and start seven-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, build the 1,000 required switch hits; right-side X targets raise the switch value in single-player games.
Use the left-orbit selector for song modes instead of assuming every named feature starts at its qualification shot.
Complete What? to light Red Hot at the right orbit; the apron card treats this as a follow-on feature.
Complete the available song features to reach Hell Bound; follow the display for its final qualification and scoring.

machineSetup: Use software v026 when possible. It is the latest public release, dated October 31, 2020.
Confirm the left-orbit selector, Start button, numbered targets, center drop, inner orbit, Spaulding, upper-playfield switches, and ramp before competitive play.

cautions.issue: The official video is launch-era, while the final public code is v026 from 2020.
cautions.response: The physical starts remain valid on v026; use the current display for values and later behavior changes.
